# The North American Journal of Economics and Finance

## Identity
- **Abbreviation:** NAJEF
- **Publisher:** Elsevier
- **ISSN:** 1062-9408 (Elsevier shop URL)
- **Homepage:** https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/the-north-american-journal-of-economics-and-finance
- **Author guidelines:** UNVERIFIED

## Scope
Per the journal description: high-quality original manuscripts in financial economics with a balance of theoretical and empirical work; topics include stock markets, capital markets, law and finance, international finance, corporate governance, behavioural finance and financial econometrics. Authors of accepted papers are encouraged to share data and code.

## Scope Keywords
financial economics, financial econometrics, stock markets, international finance, capital markets, behavioural finance

## Article Types Accepted
- Research article — other types UNVERIFIED

## Classification
- **Tier:** Q2 — SCImago SJR 2025 = 0.812; Finance Q2; Economics and Econometrics Q2 (scimagojr.com source id 24089)
- **Open Access:** Subscription/hybrid (Elsevier subscription page exists); OA APC UNVERIFIED; no mandatory APC on the subscription route
- **Field:** Financial economics

## Special Notes
Review speed: Elsevier shop page cites 39 days to first decision and about 12 % acceptance rate; a ScienceDirect snippet was garbled (5 / 96 days) — treat as UNVERIFIED. AI policy (Elsevier): AI use allowed only with oversight and disclosure, in a separate "Declaration of generative AI and AI-assisted technologies" section before the references; basic grammar/spelling/reference checkers exempt.

## Acceptance Signals
- **Selectivity band:** selective (about 12 % per Elsevier shop page)
- **Cascade / transfer:** Elsevier Article Transfer Service (publisher level; per-title UNVERIFIED)
